units.summary: New test evicts a series via CompactSelectedSeries, forces WAL truncation, and asserts the series record is retained in the checkpoint because a walExpiry is set.
units.headline: Test: evicted selected series record kept in WAL checkpoint
units.reason: New test only; no production behavior change.

units.summary: Renamed gcStaleSeries to gcSeries with a pluggable eviction predicate. numStaleSeries is now decremented only by the number of deleted series that were actually stale, rather than all deleted.
units.headline: Head gcSeries takes predicate; stale counter decremented by stale deletions only
units.reason: Changes head series accounting and the generalized eviction path for non-stale series.
focus: numStaleSeries decrement uses staleSeriesDeleted computed under lock
Stale-only path still decrements by all deleted (all are stale by predicate)

units.summary: Generalizes stale-series GC to accept a shouldEvict predicate and counts deleted series that carry a stale-NaN last value, returning that count.
units.headline: stripeSeries gcSeries uses caller predicate and counts stale deletions
units.reason: Core series deletion logic now driven by a predicate; affects what gets evicted from the head.
focus: shouldEvict is called with series lock held, as hasAppendIDAbove requires
isStaleSeries evaluated at deletion time matches the count used for numStaleSeries
